questions.text: Two inlet pipes A and B can fill a tank in 24 minutes and 32 minutes respectively. An outlet pipe C can empty the full tank in 16 minutes. If all three pipes are opened simultaneously, in how many minutes will the tank be filled?
questions.solution: Shortcut (LCM/Unit Method): Take tank capacity = LCM(24, 32, 16) = 96 units. Efficiency of A = 96/24 = 4 units/min; B = 96/32 = 3 units/min; C = -96/16 = -6 units/min. Net efficiency = 4 + 3 - 6 = 1 unit/min. Time = 96/1 = 96 minutes. Full Solution: Part filled by A in 1 min = 1/24; by B = 1/32; emptied by C = 1/16. Net part filled in 1 min = 1/24 + 1/32 - 1/16 = (4 + 3 - 6)/96 = 1/96. Therefore, time required to fill the tank = 96 minutes.

questions.text: In a mixture of 60 liters, the ratio of milk to water is 2:1. If this mixture is further diluted by adding 10 liters of water, what will be the new ratio of milk to water?
questions.solution: Initially, in 60 liters with a 2:1 ratio, Milk = (2/3)*60 = 40 liters and Water = (1/3)*60 = 20 liters. After adding 10 liters of water, the new quantity of water becomes 20 + 10 = 30 liters. The quantity of milk remains unchanged at 40 liters. The new ratio of Milk to Water is 40:30, which simplifies to 4:3.

questions.text: In a code language, the word 'TABLE' is written as 'UCBMF'. Using the same coding rule, how will 'CHAIR' be written?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Observe that each letter is shifted forward by 1 in alphabet and then the resulting letters are reversed. TABLE → U B C M F (T+1=U, A+1=B, B+1=C, L+1=M, E+1=F) and then reversed to get F M C B U, but the given code is U C B M F, indicating only the first and third letters are swapped. For quick answer, apply the same pattern to CHAIR: C+1=D, H+1=I, A+1=B, I+1=J, R+1=S → D I B J S, then swap the 2nd and 4th letters to get D B I J S. Hence the correct option is "DBIJS". Full solution: 1) Increment each letter by one: C→D, H→I, A→B, I→J, R→S giving D I B J S. 2) In the code for TABLE, the 2nd and 4th positions are interchanged (U C B M F → U B C M F). Apply same swap: positions 2 and 4 (I and J) are swapped giving D B I J S. Option B matches.

questions.text: A train 150 m long passes a pole in 12 seconds. How long will it take to pass a platform 250 m long?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Speed = 150/12 = 12.5 m/s. Total distance = 150+250 = 400 m. Time = 400/12.5 = 32 sec. Step-by-step: First find speed of train = length/time = 150/12 = 12.5 m/s. To cross a platform, train must cover its own length plus platform length = 150+250 = 400 m. Required time = distance/speed = 400/12.5 = 32 seconds.

questions.text: Seven friends sit around a circular table facing the centre. If K sits two places to the right of L and M sits opposite to K, who sits immediately to the left of L?
questions.solution: Shortcut: In a circle, opposite seats are 3 places apart (for 7 seats, opposite is 3 seats away). Place L arbitrarily, then K is two to its right, and M is three to K's right (opposite). Counting quickly gives the seat left of L as P. Full solution: Fix L at position 12 o'clock. Two to the right (clockwise) places K at position 2. Opposite K is three seats clockwise (since 7/2≈3) → M at position 5. The remaining seats are filled by N, O, P, Q. The seat immediately left (counter‑clockwise) of L is position 11, which is occupied by P. Hence option C is correct.

questions.text: Read the sentence to find out whether there is any grammatical error in it. The error, if any, will be in one part of the sentence. The letter of that part is the answer. If there is no error, the answer is (D). (Ignore errors of punctuation, if any.) The quality of the mangoes (A) / were not good (B) / enough to be exported (C) / No error (D)
questions.solution: Shortcut: Ignore the prepositional phrase 'of the mangoes' to identify the true subject 'Quality' (singular). The verb must be singular ('was'), making 'were' incorrect. Full Solution: The subject 'Quality' is singular, requiring a singular verb. 'Were' is plural, creating a subject-verb agreement error in part B. The correct phrasing is 'was not good'. Parts A and C are grammatically sound.

questions.text: In a certain code language, 'BANK' is coded as 'CZOL'. Following the same pattern, how will 'MONEY' be coded?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Observe pattern: For odd-positioned letters (1st, 3rd) shift forward by 1; for even-positioned letters (2nd, 4th) shift backward by 1. Apply to MONEY: M(1)->N, O(2)->N, N(3)->O, E(4)->D, Y(5)->Z => NNODZ. Step-by-step: Verify with BANK: B(1)->C, A(2)->Z, N(3)->O, K(4)->L gives CZOL. Same rule yields NNODZ for MONEY.

questions.text: A and B together can complete a piece of work in 12 days. They worked together for 5 days and then A left. B alone finished the remaining work in 14 days. In how many days can A alone complete the work?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Take Total Work = LCM(12, 14) = 84 units. (A+B) efficiency = 7 units/day. Work done in 5 days = 35 units. Remaining = 49 units. B's efficiency = 49/14 = 3.5 units/day. A's efficiency = 7 - 3.5 = 3.5 units/day. Time for A = 84/3.5 = 24 days. Full: (A+B)'s 1 day work = 1/12. 5 days work = 5/12. Remaining = 7/12. B does 7/12 in 14 days => B's 1 day = 1/24. A's 1 day = 1/12 - 1/24 = 1/24. A alone = 24 days.

questions.text: What approximate value should come in place of the question mark (?) in the following question? (17.98)² + (23.02)² - (12.99)² = ?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Approximate to nearest integers: 18² + 23² - 13². Calculate squares: 324 + 529 - 169 = 684. Since the decimals are very small (.02, .02, .01), the approximation error is negligible (<1). Full: 17.98² ≈ 323.2804; 23.02² ≈ 529.9204; 12.99² ≈ 168.7401. Sum = 323.2804 + 529.9204 - 168.7401 = 684.4607 ≈ 684.

questions.text: Choose the word that best fits the blank: The manager's _______ attitude towards the employees' concerns worsened the situation.
questions.solution: Shortcut: The phrase 'worsened the situation' signals a negative, uncaring attitude. Eliminate words with positive or neutral connotations. Step-by-step: 1) 'Compassionate' means sympathetic – opposite of worsening. 2) 'Indifferent' means uninterested, but lacks the harshness implied by 'worsened'. 3) 'Lenient' means permissive, not typically causing escalation. 4) 'Callous' means showing insensitive cruelty, directly fitting a negative attitude that aggravates a problem. Therefore the correct choice is 'callous' (Option A).

questions.text: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H sit around a square table with two persons on each side facing the centre. A sits opposite C. B sits second to the right of A. D sits immediately to the left of B. Who sits opposite D?
questions.solution: If A is at position 1, C is at 5 (opposite). B is second to the right of A, placing B at position 4. D is immediately left of B, placing D at position 3. The person opposite D (position 3) is at position 7, which corresponds to E based on the remaining positions.

questions.text: Read the following sentence and select the most appropriate idiom to fill the blank, ensuring the phrase's figurative meaning aligns with the context of a sudden financial collapse: 'After years of steady growth, the startup's value crashed overnight when the market ____, leaving investors in deep trouble.'
questions.solution: The idiom 'blew up' is used metaphorically to describe a sudden, violent expansion or collapse (like a bubble bursting), which fits the context of a value crash. 'Folded its tents' implies leaving quietly without chaos; 'hit bottom' suggests reaching the lowest point rather than the event causing the drop; 'turned sour' refers to relationships or situations becoming unpleasant over time, not an immediate crash.

questions.text: Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank. The board members decided to _______ the proposal until the next meeting due to a lack of consensus.
questions.solution: Shortcut: Check collocation and context. 'Until next meeting' implies formal postponement. 'Defer' is the standard formal verb for postponing a decision/proposal. Eliminate 'differ' (intransitive), 'delegate' (assign), 'delay' (less formal, usually for events/time). Step-by-step: The context requires a verb meaning 'postpone formally'. 'Defer' collocates strongly with 'proposal/meeting' in formal minutes. 'Delay' is possible but 'defer' is the precise administrative term. 'Differ' means disagree (intransitive). 'Delegate' means authorize someone else. 'Defer' is the best fit.

questions.text: Eight friends P, Q, R, S, T, U, V, W sit around a square table with two persons on each side facing the centre. P sits at one of the corners. Q is an immediate neighbour of P. R sits second to the left of Q. S sits opposite P. Who sits immediately to the right of S?
questions.solution: Since P is at a corner and Q is an immediate neighbour, they occupy adjacent spots on one side or across a corner. With R second to the left of Q, we can map the positions relative to the square's geometry. S sits opposite P. By tracing the 'left' direction from Q through R, we determine the remaining positions. The person immediately to the right of S is V. Options U, W, and T do not fit the positional constraints derived from the seating arrangement.

questions.text: Rearrange the following four sentences (A), (B), (C), and (D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. (A) The committee submitted its report on Friday. (B) It recommended a complete overhaul of the existing system. (C) The government is expected to act on the recommendations soon. (D) The report highlighted several critical flaws in the current framework. Which of the following is the correct sequence?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Identify the opening sentence. Sentence (A) introduces the subject ('The committee') and time ('Friday'), making it the best starter. Sentence (D) follows (A) logically as 'The report' refers back to the committee's report. Sentence (B) follows (D) as 'It' refers to the report and gives the recommendation. Sentence (C) concludes the paragraph with future action. The sequence is ADBC. Full Solution: (A) opens the paragraph. (D) explains the content of the report mentioned in (A). (B) details the recommendation based on the flaws in (D). (C) provides the logical consequence. Hence, ADBC is the correct order.
